title: What a Snowsports School Household Pays for an Instructor It Asked For by Name
content:
A household that asked for a named instructor pays for that instructor on its Snowsports School booking, the charge being added to the tuition raised on that booking. The amount is judged from the school's own request record against the booking.

Where a request for a named instructor stands against the booking with an outcome of confirmed, the product's instructor request fee is added. Where a request for a named instructor stands against the booking with an outcome of accepted pending confirmation, the provisional instructor charge of 35.00 USD is added. Where no request for a named instructor stands against the booking, nothing is added on that count, the charge standing at 0.00 USD.

## The instructor request fees the first band reads

| Product | Named-instructor fee (USD) |
| --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | 0.00 |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | 0.00 |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | 0.00 |
| Six-Week Development Programme | 0.00 |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | 75.00 |
| Private Instruction Full Day | 125.00 |
| Elite Performance Camp | 0.00 |

## Request, outcome and charge

| Request for a named instructor standing against the booking | Charge added |
| --- | --- |
| standing with an outcome of confirmed | the product's named-instructor fee |
| standing with an outcome of accepted pending confirmation | 35.00 USD |
| none standing | 0.00 USD |

Only requests for a named instructor are counted, and only those standing against that booking; a request of another kind, or one standing against another booking of the same household account, does not bear on the charge.

## The clause applied to hypothetical records

- A booking of the Private Instruction Full Day against which a named-instructor request stands with an outcome of confirmed carries a charge of 125.00 USD.
- The same booking, where the request stands with an outcome of accepted pending confirmation, carries a charge of 35.00 USD, whatever that product's named-instructor fee may be.
- A booking of the Semi-Private Coaching Session against which a named-instructor request stands with an outcome of confirmed carries a charge of 75.00 USD.
- A booking of the All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson against which no named-instructor request stands carries nothing on this count.
